paragraphs.text: Sardnia is an island in the southern part of the Domains on Dominaria .
Sardnia lies south of Shanodin and Orvada , and east of Ru-Nora in the Voda Sea .
Sardnia was a participant in the Bloodline Project but eventually saw Phyrexian infestation as they learned of the project through the remnants of Gatha 's research.
Eventually, some of Sardnia's ports came under the control of the Vodalian Empire .
